steps.content: Chief's Office

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: BOOOSS...
You close your weary and sore eyes, rubbing them to avoid the longing gaze from across the desk.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: BOOOSS... Oh, pretty please, give it another thought, won't you? Why rush to say no so soon?

Apparently, your effort proves futile. You sigh and look again at the blueprint that Dudu claimed to have meticulously drawn throughout the night. It resembles a peculiar house, with skewed lines and revised numbers filling the page...

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: You see, I just need... eh, seven... 720 more pieces of candy to bring this candy house blueprint to life! Pleeeeeeaaaase~~~

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Hehe, once you approve it, I'll swiftly put in a request to the Supply Office! The house will be standing by tonight!

options: Building a house within a house?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hold your horses... Let's not even talk about whether Faye can get hold of that many pieces of candy in one go...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: MBCC probably doesn't have the space for such a big candy house.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Wait, you think this is big, boss? It's not big at all!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's beside the point... What I'm wondering is, why the sudden interest in a candy house?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Well, just think about it for a second—a grand candy house at MBCC! How stunning would that be? Plus, I'll deck it out with colorful lights and bells...

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Whenever you swing open that door, hehe, the sweet candy house will definitely lift your spirits and send you off to dreamland on a high note!

"Sweet candy house," "colorful lights," "bells"... You suddenly recall walking past Dudu's room last night, when you overheard Mess and Etti enthusiastically recounting a story from a picture book to Dudu.
She must have created that blueprint based on the picture book—upon this realization, you break into a smile.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Hehe, I've noticed how hard you've been working lately, so I thought I could help you relax a bit.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: According to the picture book, you can sleep soundly and have the sweetest dreams in a candy house... It's the best idea I could come up with...

With your hectic schedule these days, you have indeed been continuously on the go for many days, severely sleep-deprived and never getting proper rest. It appears that Dudu has been closely observing your state.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Besides, you played with Mess and Etti for a long time last year. This year, I just have this tiny little request, and you can't say yes?
She can't contain her excitement, leaning closer to you. You reach out with a smile... and give her forehead a gentle flick.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Ouch! Are you really gonna say no?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I appreciate the thought... but about the candy house, I'll have to say no. Those picture book tales all tend to exaggerate things...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But if you want, I can buy some sweets, and we could all enjoy them together, just to unwind.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...How about this? I still have a few documents to take care of. Once I'm done, we can head out together to get them. How does that sound?
Your indirect comfort evidently fails to dampen Dudu's enthusiasm.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: No, I'll figure out a way! Wait for me, boss!
Dudu gives you a resolute look before turning to dart away.
In the distance, you hear a barrage of suona sounds resounding intensely in the corridor, as if the musician is fervently encouraging herself.
The ceiling light in your office suddenly flickers, and you feel a growing sense of suspicion, unsure of what intentions she might have in mind.
At night...
A brief, crisp sound of bells softly rings in your ears, coaxing you to open your eyes.
Uncertain if it's a dream, you find yourself enveloped by mist.
The ground is carpeted with thorns, and in the dense forest ahead, creatures appear to be stirring. Night owls and bats with glowing eyes lurk in the darkness, signaling an impending sense of danger.
Raising your gaze, you notice a blood moon hanging above the highest branch. A person sits there, her form obscured by the thick mist. Swinging her legs, she seems to be in a cheerful mood.
Hey, bo—oh, wandering servant, are you the gift those villagers sent my way?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: It's the Great Witch. Calling me by my name is so not cool...

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Ahem, moving on, tonight marks the blood moon, and the villagers living below the mountain should be sending an innocent servant to serve me, the Great Witch. So, looks like you're the lucky one, ${PlayerName}!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Witch, villagers, servant... What are you talking about, and where am I?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Oh, a servant full of questions, I see.
Dudu, or rather, the Great Witch, grins mischievously, lifts the suona in her hand, and begins playing a little tune to herself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Does a witch also play suona?

The discordant melody sounds strangely familiar to you. Before you can think further, the thorns beneath your feet begin to wildly grow, and a white floating figure suddenly glides past in the depths of the forest. You cautiously step back.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Scared?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Don't fret. I'm quite nice to my servants. The tasks I'll need your help with are few, in fact, just one...
She blinks, her eyes gleaming with mischief.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: I need you to collect a basket full of candy, so much that it's almost overflowing—!

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Then, we'll build a fragrant, sweet, and golden candy house!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why does Dudu want to build a candy house so badly... Wasn't she supposed to help me relax? Collecting candy sounds like a lot of work...
In a heartbeat, all the thorns and the white floating figure surge towards you.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Oh, by the way, my little pet loves candy too, so you better not let it catch you, or all your efforts will be in vain...

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: You've got this! My candy house is all on you!
